title: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, has been found in MicroPython 1.21.0/1.22.0-preview. Affected by this issue is the function poll_se
trigger: poll object registers an fd, object freed, poll set still references it
notes: Patch 8b24aa36ba97. Same defect as issue #12887.

title: A vulnerability was found in MicroPython 1.22.2
trigger: array/memoryview outlives the buffer it points into
notes: Fixed in 1.23.0. Same defect family as issue #13283.

title: A flaw has been found in micropython up to 1.27.0. This vulnerability affects the function mp_import_all of the file py/runtime.c. This manipulation c
trigger: import * over a module whose globals map is mutated during iteration
notes: NVD says CWE-119/787, not 416. Patch 570744d06c5b.

title: Use After Free at modselect.c:151
trigger: select object used after the registered stream was collected
notes: Reporter-provided ASan trace. Underlies CVE-2023-7152.

title: use after free found at micropython/py/objarray.c:509 [micropython@a5bdd39127]
trigger: array resized while a view onto its old buffer is still live
notes: ASan heap-use-after-free. Underlies CVE-2024-8947.

title: heap-use-after-free when reusing a closed btree object
trigger: btree object used again after close() released its backing store
notes: ASan heap-use-after-free, explicit reuse-after-close.

title: bug: lex->source_name used after lex is freed
trigger: lex->source_name read after the lexer allocation was freed
notes: Classic dangling pointer into a freed struct field.

title: Trivial crash when attempting to close stdin/stdout
trigger: close() on stdin/stdout then further use of the stream object
notes: Reuse-after-close on a singleton stream.

title: Resizing bytearray with active memoryviews corrupts state and segfaults
trigger: bytearray resized while active memoryviews still point at the old buffer
notes: Open. Resize reallocates, views are not invalidated.

title: `array('I')`: resizing with active memoryview leaves stale view; `readinto()` corrupts heap and segfaults during file close
trigger: array('I') resized leaves a stale memoryview; readinto() then writes through it
notes: Open. Stale view becomes a heap-corruption write primitive.

title: Segmentation fault in array sorting with GC interaction
trigger: sort over an array while the collector runs, element buffer moved or freed
notes: Open. GC interaction, not reproducible without collection pressure.

title: Null pointer dereference in dict equality after re-entrant `__bool__` clears RHS map
trigger: re-entrant __bool__ clears the RHS map during dict equality, map pointer goes NULL
notes: Open. Container mutated under an in-flight operation.

title: modio: crash when write inappropriately enlarges buf via slice assignment
trigger: write() where slice assignment enlarges buf, reallocating under the caller
notes: Open. Callback reallocates a buffer the caller still holds.

title: crash with inappropriate readblocks implementation
trigger: readblocks implementation enlarges the buffer it was handed
notes: Same shape as MPY-T13 and MPY-T15, different call site.

title: vfs_blockdev: crash when readblocks inappropriately enlarges buf via slice assignment
trigger: readblocks enlarges buf via slice assignment, caller keeps the old pointer
notes: Fixed. The canonical reallocate-under-caller case.

title: MICROPY_PORT_DEINIT_FUNC called after gc_sweep_all
trigger: port deinit hook runs after the sweep that already freed what it touches
notes: Open. Shutdown ordering defect in the collector itself.

title: raising exception in __del__ finaliser results in deadlock with multithread enabled
trigger: exception raised inside a __del__ finaliser deadlocks with threading on
notes: Open. Liveness, not memory safety. Kept for taxonomy contrast.

title: Crash in LVGL lv_draw_dispatch_layer() after gc.collect(), layer->draw_task_head corrupt
trigger: gc.collect() frees a structure the C binding still holds, draw_task_head corrupt
notes: Closed. C-side pointer invisible to the mark phase.

title: BLE: crash after running gc.collect()
trigger: gc.collect() collects a BLE object still referenced only from C
notes: Closed. Same root shape as MPY-T18.

title: esp32: gc.collect() causes panic
trigger: gc.collect() panics, collector state inconsistent with the IDF heap
notes: Closed. Two allocators sharing one address space.

title: rp2: Script using _thread crashes without explicit GC call
trigger: thread stack memory collected because it is not a scanned root
notes: Closed. Root-set gap: a live pointer the mark phase cannot see.

title: multi-thread file access causing system crash
trigger: concurrent file access, allocator state mutated from two threads
notes: Open. A data race; capabilities bound reach, not concurrency.

title: Sporadic GuruMeditation, presumed related to TCP/IP LWIP
trigger: sporadic fault, buffer freed by the network stack still referenced
notes: Closed as unreproducible. Kept as a known-suspect entry.

title: ports/embed: segfault in mp_compile()
trigger: mp_compile() on an embed port faults on a freed lexer or parse tree
notes: Closed. Related to MPY-T07.

title: printing to io.StringIO subclass leads to seg fault
trigger: printing to a StringIO subclass re-enters and invalidates the target buffer
notes: Open. Buffer reallocated under an in-flight print.

title: Segmentation Fault (NULL Pointer Dereference) in mp_native_relocate
trigger: relocation walks a pointer table that is NULL or already freed
notes: Closed. NULL deref rather than a stale-but-mapped read.

title: usock: if connect() fails, socket is considered open -> not cleaned up
trigger: failed connect() leaves the socket considered open, never cleaned up
notes: Open. Leak plus a later reuse hazard, not a spatial violation.

title: gc_realloc returns NULL after a few calls
trigger: gc_realloc returns NULL after a few calls, caller keeps using the old block
notes: Closed, 2014. Oldest specimen; allocator invariant, not yet a UAF.

title: The assert in gc_free(...) and gc_realloc(...) will fail
trigger: assertions in gc_free and gc_realloc fail on a pointer they consider invalid
notes: Closed. Direct evidence the allocator cannot validate its own input.

title: gc.collect() does not work properly
trigger: gc.collect() does not reclaim what the caller expects, blocks stay marked live
notes: Open, needs-info. Over-retention, the dual of premature free.
